reviews.text: I have been taking my dogs here every 2 weeks for years. Haircut then bath then haircut then bath. While the little girl that we have left doesn't really like going due to her separation anxiety,  she is always well cared for and groomed properly.
They did an amazing job on Lil'bit! Highly recommended!!

We had a skunk attack our dog and we were desperate to get him washed. Grooming by Gloria worked us in!! We were so grateful.another groomer we had used in the past only had voice mail and did return our call until 10:00 pm with an appointment several days away.
I've taken all my dogs to Gloria since 2017

Gloria always does a terrific job grooming my rescue German Shepherd at a fair price. He loves going there. 5 Stars every time. Elise is an excellent groomer there as well. I got my German Shepherd bathed and groomed today with a special “mud bath” procedure designed to help with the undercoat as well. The photo of him in the back of the van was taken today as we got ready to depart for home.

Please don't ever take your dog or any other animal for that matter. My dog was left with blisters all over her poor body .  My dog was burnt  from head to tail.  Had her fur falling out for months on end.  I would never take her there again.  Please heed warning!!
LOVE Gloria's!!!!!... Gloria & Elyse are great with my pups!... prices are great & reasonable!... They are very accommodating to my schedule.  Highly recommend Gloria's for your fur-baby needs!

My puppies four months old took her for her first Grooming. She had a bad experience. I had a bad experience five hours later. No Call showed up to check on her. Nothing was being done. I will never take her back again, Grooming by Gloria needs to hire better people

I called and asked if anyone on staff can do stripping on a wirehair dachshund.

Direct quote "I do but you're looking at $200."

I said great, it's hard to find anyone who does it, I just need to get it done. Trying to schedule and met with....

Insert loud sigh :"All you do is get a pair of scissors, open them, and pull the hair out. Do you really want your dog to go through that much pain?"

I didn't call for a lecture. If you don't want to do the treatment, say you don't offer it.
Great groomer.  Friendly and very caring of your pet

They did an awesome job and my pup was home quickly. Excellent service for the first time very reasonable prices and very friendly. Definitely will be back they have earned my trust with my Big Boy. He is a golden doodle.

Great prices, good grooming service, not so great customer service. But they know what they're doing, and that's why I go here.
Our dogs fur can sometimes get matted pretty bad. They take the time to dematt, and make sure her coat is nice and soft when we pick her up.

Been here 4 times over the last year and every time, we've never been disappointed.

The only thing is they're not very outgoing towards customers from what I've seen and experienced. If that were to change, definitely would rate 5 stars.

Would recommend for grooming over any other location I've tried.
The ladies were amazing and my fur baby came home so happy !!
